anti_overlap: Focuses on multi-system legibility and information layering, not atmosphere or typography
decision_lens: Layered complexity — can multiple information systems coexist on one interface without confusion?
distance_rationale: Precision mechanical instruments from 600 years ago — no shared practice with web development whatsoever
expected_isomorphisms: Concentric information layers as page depth levels, pointer hierarchy as link styling, complication management as section scaling, master/subsidiary dials as primary/secondary navigation
focus: Astronomical clock design — how to display multiple complex systems (time, celestial mechanics, calendar) on a single readable face
name: fd-astronomical-clockwork-legibility
persona: Horological historian who studies the design of medieval astronomical clocks (Prague, Strasbourg, Wells)
review_areas: Concentric information layers — does the wiki present system overview, detail, and formula as readable layers?
Dial legibility — can each information layer be read independently?
Pointer hierarchy — do different types of links/references have visually distinct treatments?
Complication vs clarity — does adding a new system (section) degrade readability of existing ones?
Temporal indicators — does the wiki show which content is current vs historical vs planned?
Master dial vs subsidiary — is there a clear primary navigation with secondary detail panels?

severity_examples.condition: No visual distinction between link types
severity_examples.scenario: Cross-references, external links, and internal navigation all look the same

severity_examples.condition: Navigation doesn't scale gracefully with content growth
severity_examples.scenario: Adding the prestige and aspirations pages degraded sidebar legibility

source_domain: Medieval astronomical clock design (14th-16th century European horology)
success_hints: The wiki's multiple information layers (7 sections, 31 pages, cross-references, formulas) are as legible as a well-designed astronomical clock — complex but not confusing
task_context: The wiki documents 15+ interconnected game systems — like an astronomical clock, it must display multiple complex systems in a single navigable interface
